name: blueprint
description: Prepares pinned REA/Ghidra tooling without a global install, enforces a registry of targets the maintainer authorised, and writes a reproducible inventory of an authorised target with REA evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Inventory an authorised target with pinned REA evidence.
interface.longDescription: Prepares pinned REA, Ghidra and JDK in a data directory after an explicit plan, refuses any target absent from the maintainer's registry, and writes a reproducible inventory (modules, types, UI strings, resources) where unreadable facts are unknown.
